title: Switch a Rune Off and Keep It After Leaving Runes

steps.intent: start a Claude Bare tab on an unlocked vault, open Runes and press Modify
press a rune's State switch until it reads State: Off; open Add Rune and check an addable rune's switch reads State: Off or State: On
press Delete Rune on another rune, then press Cancel on the notice to back out halfway
press Done, leave Runes and come back
check the cancelled rune is still listed, the vault is still the one in use, and the rune I switched keeps its State
